QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year 2018] 8-Blessing Ring
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Administrator is handing out 8-Blessing Rings for the Lunar New Year. Get one of your very own by collecting No-Blessing Charms x88 from field monsters and trading them to the Maple Administrator.
